name: bn-analysis
description: Infer, score, bootstrap and visualize Bayesian networks from expression matrices (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell, proteomics) with the FastBN Hill-Climb + Tabu learner, and benchmark the result against a known network.

interface.shortDescription: Infer and visualize networks from omics data
interface.longDescription: Drives the FastBN pipeline end to end: inspect an expression matrix, derive learning parameters from the number of samples, variables and discretization levels, learn a DAG with Hill-Climb + Tabu search, compute edge importance, estimate edge stability by bootstrap resampling, compare experimental groups, draw the network and bundle everything into an HTML report. Also scores a learned structure against a known pathway or gold-standard network (SHD, directed/skeleton precision-recall-F1, SID, KL).
defaultPrompt: Infer a gene network from counts.tsv and visualize it.
Bootstrap the edge stability of this network.
Compare the learned network with the known pathway.
